$comment: Closed category vocabulary for mcp-server entries (entry-core.v1.schema.json's `category`, internal project documentation Section 3.6). Aligned to the GA4GH API specification family the server implements or wraps, matching the packages already in ga4gh-plugins (internal project documentation Section 4.1, Section 8). Which exact standard(s) and version(s) an entry touches is recorded precisely in server._meta['org.ga4gh/ai-registry'].ga4gh_standards[] and in the common core's ga4gh_standards[]; `category` is the coarser browse/filter grouping. Phase 6 (internal project documentation) added tes/crypt4gh/phenopackets/pedigree/rnaget: these ga4gh-plugins packages exist and needed a real category, not a blanket 'other', following the same targeted-addition discipline D15 established for service-info.

categories.name: Other GA4GH-standard or genomics/health data source
